description: This PHP script handles the deletion of bugs associated with test execution in the TestLink project. It initializes page arguments, performs permission checks, updates bug status, logs audit events, and displays messages to the user.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves arguments from GET request with validation and defaults.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has right to view or execute test plans.
